name: Footage card, label cycle
what: Your footage on a rounded card in the middle of a dark warm scene with a soft glow: the card shrinks into place, pops bigger and settles, and five bold gold labels take turns above it - each rises from behind the card, floats a little, and is pushed up and out as the next one comes.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f6 the card shrinks from x1.09 to x0.96 with a smear; f10-f18 it pops to x1.08, sinks 25 px (240-scale) and tilts ~1.8 deg; f18-f32 it settles to x1.0; then a gold label comes up over the card every 27 f (f16, f43, f70, f97, f124): rising from behind the card's top edge with an overshoot, floating down and up (~7 px swing) for 26 f, then pushed up out of the frame as the next one comes
